layout.arrangement: A single title slide. The slide canvas is a large light-gray rectangle with a thin crimson/red outline, inset from the white video margins (roughly 6%–94% of image width, 8%–96% of image height). The two-line title is centered horizontally in the upper-middle of the gray canvas (first line 'Revision of' centered at ~38% of image height, second line 'Perceptron Algorithm' centered at ~52%). A small yellow rounded badge containing the slide number '2' sits in the extreme top-right corner of the gray canvas, just inside the red border. A solid black horizontal bar runs along the very bottom of the image, slightly wider than the gray slide frame.

recreation_brief:
1. SLIDE SETUP — Create a 16:9 slide, 13.333 in × 7.5 in. Set the entire slide background to white (#FFFFFF); this white area represents the video margin surrounding the slide.
2. SLIDE CANVAS — Insert one rectangle: left 0.80 in, top 0.58 in, width 11.73 in, height 6.61 in (spanning 6%–94% of width and 8%–96% of height). Fill light gray #E9E9E9; outline crimson #C00000 at 1.25 pt (source range 1–1.5 pt); no shadow. This red outline is the slide frame.
3. TITLE — Insert a text box at left 3.60 in, top 1.95 in, width 6.13 in, height 2.18 in (covering ~27%–73% of width, ~26%–55% of height). Type exactly two lines, paragraph alignment centered: line 1 'Revision of', line 2 'Perceptron Algorithm'. Font: bold sans-serif (Arial), color #C00000, size ~34 pt (source estimate 32–36 pt). Set line spacing so the center of line 1 sits at ~2.85 in (38% of slide height) and the center of line 2 at ~3.90 in (52% of slide height) — a line pitch of ~1.05 in, i.e., line spacing ≈ 2.0 (equivalently, one blank line between the two lines). No bullets, no italics, no underline.
4. SLIDE-NUMBER BADGE — Insert a rounded rectangle (pill-style corner radius) at left 11.90 in, top 0.74 in, width 0.55 in, height 0.47 in, so its right edge sits ~0.09 in inside the red frame's right edge and its top edge ~0.16 in below the frame's top edge. Fill pale yellow #FFFF99; outline purple-violet #6633CC at ~1 pt. Type the numeral '2' centered inside the shape, color #6633CC, regular weight, ~13 pt (source estimate 12–14 pt).
5. BOTTOM BLACK BAR — Insert a solid black (#000000) rectangle with no outline: left 0.52 in, top 7.19 in, width 12.29 in (92% of slide width), height 0.31 in (bottom 4% of the frame). It sits directly below the red frame's bottom edge and extends ~0.28 in past the frame on both the left and right sides. (This bar is the video-player strip captured in the source frame; include it to match the extracted image, or omit it if rebuilding only the original slide.)
6. FINAL CHECK — The slide must contain exactly these four elements on the white surround: (a) gray canvas with thin red border, (b) two-line bold red centered title 'Revision of' / 'Perceptron Algorithm', (c) yellow '2' badge in the top-right, (d) black bottom bar. Nothing else: no bullets, equations, charts, logos, footers, or images.
